verdict.rationale: Anytype's own API reference is versioned with dated releases (2025-11-08 latest, 2025-05-20, 2025-04-22), has a v1/v2 version picker and a changelog, and the OpenAPI spec carries a version string, so the versioning half of the story is documented first-party. The evidence explicitly states no written deprecation policy page is published, so the deprecation-policy half is unmet. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy (sunset timelines, support windows, deprecation notices), independent or hands-on corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The API reference is versioned with dated releases: "API Version: 2025-11-08"
No written deprecation policy page and no try-it console are published.
